title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Mera Naam Joker
desc: Raju faces heartbreak and struggles in love throughout his life. As a circus clown, he hides his pain behind laughter, making others smile at the cost of his own sorrows.

title: Raid 2
desc: Income Tax officer Amay Patnaik takes on a corrupt nexus in Bhoj, exposing Dada Bhai's sinister empire. As deceit unravels, one question remains-can truth defeat power?

title: Baazigar
desc: A ruthless killer seeking revenge seduces a businessman's elder daughter, stages her murder as suicide, then sets out to destroy the rest of her family.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
desc: Arjun and Pyare, two cops from the same station, are wrongly accused of multiple crimes. Their probe reveals the real offenders are their own lookalike impostors.

title: Jism
desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Radhe Shyam
desc: In 1970s Europe, famous palmist Vikramaditya falls in love with Prerana, a doctor. But their relationship is shaken by his strong belief in destiny and her serious illness.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: Runway 34
desc: Two pilots make a risky landing in Thiruvananthapuram due to bad weather. Trouble begins when aviation authorities investigate the incident, uncovering deeper issues.

title: Don 2
desc: After ruling the Asian underworld, Don targets Europe's criminal scene. Trapped between the Berlin mafia and relentless law enforcement, he fights to survive betrayal.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Eagle
desc: An infamous, ruthless contract killer cleverly conceals his dark, lethal operations within the illegal arms trade by posing as a humble, ordinary cotton farmer in town.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.
